text:
kai: Quick heads-up — I hit a 404 on the FR onboarding doc in staging.

kai: The markdown at /docs/getting-started/local-setup/index.md references `/static/images/fr/onboarding-screenshot.png` but that file is a symlink to `../assets/onboarding.png` which isn't present in the build container.

kai: repro: `ls -la docs/static/images/fr` -> `onboarding-screenshot.png -> ../assets/onboarding.png` (broken target).

michelle: ugh, thanks. was that symlink added recently?

kai: looks like it — git blame points to @sam from the assets reorg last month.

sam: guilty. I deduped images with symlinks to avoid copies across locales. Didn't realize the static-site builder in our container doesn't follow symlinks. my bad.

sam: I can open a tiny PR to replace the symlink with a real file under `static/images/fr/` and add a sanity check in docs CI.

michelle: SGTM. please add a small check in the docs build so we fail early if any `(/static/images/...)` referenced in markdown is missing.

sam: plan: add scripts/docs-asset-check.sh and hook into docs CI. tempfile proof-of-concept:```bash
# scripts/docs-asset-check.sh
set -e
for img in $(grep -oP "\(/static/images/[^)]+\)" -R docs | sed 's/^(//;s/)$//'); do
  if [ ! -f "$img" ]; then
    echo "MISSING: $img" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
done
```

sam: I'll include a short note in the PR body explaining why symlinks aren't safe (container fs + builder behaviour). pinging @docs-codeowners in the PR. :memo:

kai: please add a CHANGELOG line and a sentence in the PR about the root cause so future contributors don't reintroduce symlinks.

sam: will do. pushing branch now. PR link when ready.

docs-bot: CI queued for PR #2002 — docs/asset-check (pending) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

michelle: once CI green i can review/approve. thanks for jumping on it. :rocket:

sam: PR #2002 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2002 — includes copied image, asset-check script, and changelog note.

kai: verified staging after merge — FR onboarding page now renders. nice quick turnaround, team! :tada:
